compute.cost_note: one variance_audit pass per benchmark text; tier 2 uses spaCy unless --no-tier2

do_not_use_when: you want an authorship or AI judgment; this only reports reproducibility of the framework's outputs
you have no fixed benchmark text set to snapshot

examples.description: Snapshot current behavior over a benchmark set

inputs.target: a benchmark directory of .txt/.md files, plus a prior snapshot for check

artifacts: drift report, Markdown or JSON (check mode)

purpose: Infrastructure-drift detector. snapshot records variance_audit signal values and threshold constants over a fixed benchmark set together with the dependency-stack versions; check recomputes them and reports per-signal stable, drifted or unknown verdicts, so a spaCy, model, NLTK, scipy or Python change that moves outputs is caught before claims are published.
todo_reason: Blocked by a reproducibility bug: take_snapshot() stores a failed benchmark measurement as {"error": ...}, and detect_drift() then compares the absent signals and compression dictionaries without checking for that error, so a failure present at both snapshot and check is reported as no drift. Curated content is kept below; promote once errored benchmarks are refused or reported as unknown.
use_when: after upgrading spaCy, its model, NLTK, scipy or Python, before relying on earlier calibrated thresholds
pinning a reproducibility snapshot alongside published results
